input.justification: Option 1A has the highest net uplift (CHF 575 after CHF 95 total compensation against a CHF 670 rush premium), and both bumps are one day. Atelier Rochat (flexible up to 4 days, exhibition three weeks out) gets CHF 50 via capture less, and Studio Meier Licht (flexible up to 5 days, prepaid) gets CHF 45 via PayPal Payout. Keller, Alpine Drone Works and Vuilleumier were excluded as not flexible.

input.message: Bonjour Monsieur Rochat, nous devons libérer un créneau pour une commande urgente d'un autre client. Serait-il possible de reporter la livraison de vos cadres de table du mardi au mercredi ? En compensation, nous vous versons CHF 50, crédités par une réduction de la capture sur votre autorisation PayPal existante. Merci de votre compréhension.
input.message_en: Hello Mr. Rochat, we need to free a slot for an urgent order from another customer. Would it be possible to move delivery of your table frames from Tuesday to Wednesday? As compensation we will give you CHF 50, applied as a reduced capture on your existing PayPal authorization. Thank you for your understanding.

input.message: Grüezi Frau Meier, wir müssen einen Termin für einen dringenden Notfall eines anderen Kunden freihalten. Dürften wir die Lieferung Ihrer Lampenschirme vom Mittwoch auf den Donnerstag verschieben? Als Entschädigung erhalten Sie CHF 45 per PayPal Payout, da Sie bereits bezahlt haben. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis.
input.message_en: Hello Ms. Meier, we need to keep a slot free for an emergency from another customer. Could we move delivery of your lamp shades from Wednesday to Thursday? As compensation you will receive CHF 45 via PayPal Payout, since you have prepaid. Thank you for your understanding.
